restartNotice: Previous comparison results are superseded because additional billable Cowork self-review prompts were a controller error. Ten fresh SharePoint-connected builds now use controller-only review. Historical costs remain excluded audit data; no review-cost deduction is estimated.
unitNote: Observed Cowork task credits, not currency or a tenant invoice. Final cumulative readings are not added to initial readings.
timingNote: Elapsed wall-clock seconds from build submission to observed first response and final reviewed result. Approval waits and recorded interruptions remain included. These are not pure model execution times; missing completion timestamps are unavailable, not zero. Timing instrumentation began during Test 2 run-01.
evidenceNote: Exact prompts, visible transcripts, app screenshots, approval records, backend snapshots and raw cost evidence are retained privately. Public data is an explicit allowlisted projection, not a raw transcript export.

setup.message: Run 1 is complete but not accepted: 340 first-output and 1142 final task credits, 10/100 initially and 65/100 finally. Live reads, navigation and mobile UI work; Dataverse writes fail with HTTP400 Invalid organization URL null provided. Nine further builds are paused until an approved write-capable binding is established, rather than charging repeatedly for the same unresolved backend boundary.

retiredSetup.reason: User corrected the supplied tenant; registration disabled and resources left untouched.

retiredDataverseDiagnostic.reason: Stopped before schema approval when the user requested normal procurement-use-case framing.

excelRestart.message: The OneDrive workbook and its two structured tables are verified, but the pilot did not establish a managed-app connection. The supported table-binding path returned HTTP403: operation is not on the managed-apps allowlist, at its table-schema metadata step. No measured Excel builds were started.
excelRestart.actionModeEvidence: An earlier claimed action-mode attempt actually used table mode and was retracted. A standalone action-mode command was not executed because support under the connector-specific documented flow was not established. No successful or failed action-mode execution is claimed.
